description.text: Magmortar VS Electivire, a Japanese Versus Starter Pack: two ready-built 30-card half decks, one led by Magmortar and one by Electivire, to play against a friend or family member straight away, with damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book. It came out on 26 October 2007, the same day as the twin expansions Moonlit Pursuit and Dawn Dash. Latias is in the Magmortar deck and Latios in the Electivire deck.
